title: Suspected drone attack kills Filipino seafarer aboard oil tanker in Persian Gulf
summary: One Filipino seafarer died when an explosion hit the Marshall Islands-flagged oil products tanker MT Velos Sapphire in the Persian Gulf on November 5, 2026.
